comparison_scope: Original-frame controls over the requested calendar window. Donchian coverage is evaluated separately. Small samples and no untouched result prevent ranking.
original_reproduction: Published native campaign, cost and Strategy API aggregates match exactly; original outputs keep their full historical archive including six hours after the Donchian cutoff.

risk_normalization.financing: Annual scenario charged at NY 17:00 weekdays, Wednesday triple, using known mark and remaining size. At uncertain intrabar rollover include charge until an exit is observed.
risk_normalization.policy: Use all archived causal READY offers, recompute sizes from current cash and one-position occupancy, and reject before fill if the quote is unaffordable. Preserve the three target legs, close after invalid open, time exit and next-bar S5 +0.05R lock after TP1. RC2 Fixed SL preserves its initial stop. Standard OHLC uses stop first after opening orders and conservative limit fill prices. This model is separate from the frozen native baseline.
